expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' displays a circular loading spinner in the center of its image even though the image itself has fully rendered behind it. The stale spinner obscures the photo and suggests the card is still loading.

The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different treatments: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/translucent circle with a low-contrast heart, making it harder to see.
